PSBS Biak vs Persita: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of an important Indonesian Liga 1 match, where the newly promoted side, PSBS Biak, hosts Persita Tangerang at their nominal home ground, the Batakan Stadium in Balikpapan. This is a battle between teams from the lower part of the league table, where every point is doubly valuable in the fight for survival.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK) Stadium: Batakan Stadium, Balikpapan Competition: Indonesia Super League

PSBS Biak vs Persita: Match Preview

PSBS Biak, last season's Liga 2 champions, are finding it difficult to adapt to the realities of the top division. The team, known as the 'Pacific Storm,' is forced to play its home games far from their native island, which doesn't add to their stability. Persita, a more experienced Liga 1 contender, is also not in the best form and is fighting to stay in the elite division. This match will be the first official encounter between the clubs in the top tier of Indonesian football, which adds extra intrigue.

Team Form and Analysis

PSBS Biak

The team, led by Argentine specialist Juan Esnáider, relies on its foreign players, among whom Brazilian forward Alexsandro, the top scorer of Liga 2, stands out. PSBS has yet to boast consistent results, alternating rare successful matches with defeats. However, at home (albeit nominally), the team feels more confident and will be eager to claim three vital points to escape the relegation zone.

Persita

The 'Cisadane Warriors' are going through a tough time. The team has shown poor performance in away matches and is struggling to score goals. In the last round, Persita lost away to Madura United, extending their winless streak on the road. The head coach will be counting on the experience of his leaders, such as Argentine forward Ramiro Fergonzi and team captain Muhammad Toha, to turn the negative tide.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • PSBS Biak (4-3-3): Maring; Sanadi, Cherifiano, Molins, Rumakiek; Tahgabei, Ardiansyah, Arsa; Karikari, Alexsandro, Argañaraz.
  • Persita (4-2-3-1): Kuniawan; Toha, Guseynov, Chariton, Jardim; Bachna, Sinsook; Vidal, Fergonzi, Sahrul; Altindig.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This is a match between two struggling teams, so the outcome is quite difficult to predict. PSBS has a home advantage, even if it's nominal. Persita has more experience but performs terribly away from home.

  • Main Prediction: PSBS Biak to Win or Draw (1X). The league newcomers will be highly motivated to get points in a home game against a direct competitor. Given Persita's poor away form, the hosts should at least avoid defeat.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. A match between two underdogs where the cost of a mistake is very high is unlikely to be high-scoring. Both teams will focus on defense, which will likely result in a low number of goals.

Lion City Sailors vs Bangkok United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the AFC Champions League Two group stage, where the champions of Singapore, Lion City Sailors, host the leaders of Group F, Thailand's Bangkok United, at their Jalan Besar Stadium. For the hosts, this is the last chance to stay in the fight for the tournament, while the visitors can secure their place in the knockout stages with a win.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 10:00 UTC (13:00 MSK) Stadium: Jalan Besar Stadium, Singapore Competition: AFC Champions League Two

Lion City Sailors vs Bangkok United: Match Preview

Bangkok United comes into this match as the undisputed leader of the group, with a maximum point haul after three rounds. The team from Thailand is in magnificent form, unbeaten in their last 15 matches across all competitions. In the previous round, Bangkok comfortably defeated Lion City 2-0 at home. Lion City, in contrast, is the group's underdog, having lost all three of their previous matches without scoring a single goal. The Singaporean club is having a disastrous season, sitting in fifth place in their domestic league, which has led to a change of coach.

Team Form and Analysis

Lion City Sailors

The Singaporean giants are in a deep crisis. The team has lost five of its last six matches, which was the reason for the head coach's dismissal. The Sailors have the worst attack and the worst defense in the group, having conceded 7 goals and scored none. The team's only hope is the home-field advantage with its artificial turf, which not all opponents can quickly adapt to. In attack, all hopes rest on the experienced Belgian import, Maxime Lestienne.

Bangkok United

The team, led by Totchtawan Sripan, is at the peak of its form. The 'Bangkok Angels' are confidently leading both their group in Asia and the Thai league. The team is known for its solid defense - they have yet to concede a goal in the AFC Champions League Two. In attack, Brazilian forward Willen Mota has been shining, having already scored in this tournament. Bangkok United will be aiming for a fourth consecutive victory to secure the top spot in the group ahead of schedule.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Lion City Sailors (4-3-3): Rohaizad; Tan, Harun, Henrique, Stewart; Kumar, Suparno, Shahiran; Lestienne, Živković, Anwar.
  • Bangkok United (4-2-3-1): Budprom; Doh, Bihr, Everton, Selinon; Puangchan, Anan; Rungrat, Eid, Vander Luiz; Mota.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Bangkok United is the absolute favorite for this encounter. Their incredible form, combined with Lion City's deep crisis, makes a victory for the visitors almost a foregone conclusion. It will be extremely difficult for the Singaporean club, which is in the process of rebuilding, to offer any resistance to one of the best teams in Southeast Asia at the moment.

  • Main Prediction: Bangkok United to Win with a (-1) Handicap. The visitors are significantly superior in class and should win comfortably to secure their qualification from the group early.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Bangkok United to Win to Nil. The Sailors have yet to score in this campaign, while Bangkok has not conceded. This trend is likely to continue.

Pohang Steelers vs Tampines Rovers: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a key match in the fourth round of the AFC Champions League Two group stage, where South Korea's Pohang Steelers host Singaporean champions Tampines Rovers at their Pohang Steel Yard stadium. For the hosts, this is a chance to get revenge for the sensational defeat in the first leg and reclaim the top spot in Group H, while the visitors will try to cause another upset.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 10:00 UTC (13:00 MSK) Stadium: Pohang Steel Yard, Pohang Competition: AFC Champions League Two

Pohang Steelers vs Tampines Rovers: Match Preview

Pohang Steelers come into this match with a huge desire to redeem themselves. In the previous round, the Korean giants unexpectedly lost 1-0 away to Tampines Rovers, which was their first defeat in the current tournament campaign. This result allowed the Singaporean club to take the lead in the group. Despite this setback, Pohang remains a formidable force, especially on their home turf. Tampines Rovers, on the other hand, are in excellent form, unbeaten in their last four matches and having conceded only one goal in three group stage games.

Team Form and Analysis

Pohang Steelers

The team, led by Park Tae-ha, has shown mixed form recently, alternating wins and losses in the K-League. However, their last domestic league game ended with a confident 1-0 victory over Gimcheon Sangmu, which should have boosted the team's confidence. Pohang's coach stated in a pre-match interview that the team has learned from the defeat in Singapore and has strategically prepared to take three points and score multiple goals. The Korean club relies on aggressive, attacking football, as evidenced by their high number of corner kicks.

Tampines Rovers

The Singaporean club, managed by Noh Rahman, has become the main revelation of Group H. 'The Stags' display a well-organized defense and effectively use counter-attacks, which brought them success in the first match. The team is on the rise, performing successfully in their domestic league as well. The key player in their attack is the fast Australian forward Trent Buhagiar, who can decide the outcome of a moment on his own. Tampines is known for its high discipline, averaging less than one yellow card per game.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Pohang Steelers (4-2-3-1): Hwang In-jae; Shin Kwang-hoon, Jonathan Aspropotamitis, Park Chan-yong, Wanderson; Kim Jong-woo, Oberdan; Kim In-sung, Paulo Afonso, Hong Yoon-sang; Lee Ho-jae.
  • Tampines Rovers (3-4-3): Syazwan Buhari; Amirul Adli, Shuya Yamashita, Dylan Fox; Irfan Najeeb, Shah Shahiran, Jacob Mahler, Amirul Haikal; Faris Ramli, Trent Buhagiar, Glenn Kweh.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the sensational defeat in the first leg, Pohang Steelers are the undisputed favorites for the home match. The home-field advantage, the desire for revenge, and the difference in class should be decisive. Tampines Rovers will once again try to play defensively, but containing the pressure from a motivated Korean club at the Steel Yard will be extremely difficult.

  • Main Prediction: Pohang Steelers to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals.

Beijing Guoan vs Wofoo Tai Po: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the AFC Champions League Two group stage, where China's Beijing Guoan hosts Wofoo Tai Po from Hong Kong at their Workers' Stadium in Beijing. For the hosts, this is a crucial match in their fight to keep their qualification hopes alive, while the visitors will aim to solidify their position in the upper part of the table.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 12:15 UTC (15:15 MSK) Stadium: Workers' Stadium, Beijing Competition: AFC Champions League Two

Beijing Guoan vs Wofoo Tai Po: Match Preview

Beijing Guoan comes into this match at the bottom of the group standings with two points from three games. The previous encounter between these teams in Hong Kong ended in a high-scoring 3-3 draw, which was the Chinese club's only point-scoring game in that match. Wofoo Tai Po, on the other hand, sits in third place with four points and continues to fight for a playoff spot. In their last domestic league match, Beijing Guoan secured a big 4-0 win over Changchun Yatai, which should have boosted their confidence after a series of poor results. Wofoo Tai Po is also in excellent form, having thrashed Hong Kong Rangers 6-1 in their last match.

Team Form and Analysis

Beijing Guoan

The Chinese club has been experiencing serious defensive issues in this AFC Champions League campaign, conceding 8 goals in three matches, the worst record in the group. However, their attack has been quite effective, scoring 10 goals in their last five official games. The leader of their attack is Portuguese forward Fábio Abreu, who has 26 goals this season. The home stadium should be a key advantage for Guoan in this decisive match.

Wofoo Tai Po

The team from Hong Kong is on a roll, being unbeaten in their last four matches. Tai Po has shown impressive goal-scoring form, netting 13 goals in their last five games. Brazilian forward Michel Renner, who scored a brace in the first match against Beijing Guoan, is a standout player. Despite being the underdogs, Tai Po proved in the first game that they can compete and effectively capitalize on their chances.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Beijing Guoan (4-3-3): Hou Sen; Wang Gang, Ngadeu-Ngadjui, Wu Shaocong, Li Lei; Guga, Dawhan, Cao Yongjing; Liangming Lin, Fábio Abreu, Zhang Yuning.
  • Wofoo Tai Po (4-3-3): Tse Ka-Wing; Lee Ka-Ho, Gabriel, Daciel, Weverton; Mikael, Dujardin, Phan Ngan-Cheuk; Igor Sartori, Michel Renner, Paulo Simionato.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite their problems, Beijing Guoan are the favorites for this home match. The necessity to win and the home-field advantage should motivate the Chinese team. However, Wofoo Tai Po is in excellent form and has already proven that they should not be underestimated.

  • Main Prediction: Beijing Guoan to Win. The hosts have their backs against the wall and will go all out to get the three points and get back into the race for qualification.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. The first meeting between the teams ended 3-3. Both teams have been scoring a lot in their recent matches and have defensive issues, which sets the stage for a high-scoring game.

Selangor vs Persib: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the AFC Champions League Two group stage, where Malaysia's Selangor hosts Indonesia's Persib Bandung at the Petaling Jaya Stadium. This is a key meeting for both teams, who are competing for qualification from Group G.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 12:15 UTC (15:15 MSK) Stadium: Petaling Jaya Stadium, Petaling Jaya Competition: AFC Champions League Two

Selangor vs Persib: Match Preview

Persib comes into this match as the group leader, with 7 points from three games. Selangor sits in second place with four points. The previous encounter between these teams in Indonesia ended in a 2-2 draw, where Selangor managed to equalize in the last minute. Persib is in excellent form, unbeaten in their last six matches across all competitions. In their last Liga 1 fixture, they comfortably defeated Persita 3-0. Selangor, on the other hand, is in a slump, having failed to win in their last three games.

Team Form and Analysis

Selangor

The Malaysian club, which is second in its domestic league, relies on an attacking style of play. Chilean forward Ronnie Fernández, who has already scored 4 goals in this AFC Champions League Two campaign, is a standout player. However, the 'Red Giants' have serious defensive issues, having conceded in each of their three group stage matches. The home-field advantage, where the team has lost only once this season, should be a key asset for Selangor.

Persib Bandung

The Indonesian giants, under the guidance of Bojan Hodak, display a very organized and pragmatic style of football. The 'Bandung Tigers' have the best defense in the group, having conceded only two goals. In attack, Brazilian imports David da Silva and Ciro have been leading the line, with two goals each in the tournament. Persib has been successful on the road, remaining unbeaten in their last three away matches.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Selangor (4-3-3): Chan; Quentin Cheng, Harith, Richmond, Daniels; Halim, Brendan Gan, Ezequiel; Al-Halaq, Ronnie Fernández, Majid.
  • Persib (4-2-3-1): Mendoza; Henhen, Kuipers, Irianto, Aziz; Klok, Kusumantoro; Febriyanto, Ciro, Rahmat; David da Silva.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Selangor is playing at home, Persib appears to be the slight favorite. Their current form, solid defense, and ability to perform away from home make their chances of success more favorable. Selangor, on the other hand, is in a slump and has defensive problems.

  • Main Prediction: Persib to Win or Draw (X2). The Indonesian club is on a roll and will aim to at least avoid defeat to maintain their group leadership. A draw in this match would be an acceptable result for them.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. The first meeting between the teams was high-scoring (2-2). Selangor scores a lot at home, and Persib has a potent attack. An exchange of goals in such a game is highly likely.

Spartak Moskva vs Lokomotiv Moskva: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the main Moscow derby in the FONBET Russian Cup RPL Path quarter-finals, where Spartak hosts Lokomotiv at the Lukoil Arena. This will be the fourth meeting between the teams this season, and every clash between these fierce rivals promises an uncompromising battle and intense emotions.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 16:30 UTC (19:30 MSK) Stadium: Lukoil Arena, Moscow Competition: Russian Cup

Spartak Moskva vs Lokomotiv Moskva: Match Preview

The teams approach the cup derby in different moods. Spartak, under Dejan Stanković, currently 6th in the RPL, is experiencing some difficulties, having lost their last league match to Krasnodar (1-2). Lokomotiv, sitting in 5th place, also lost their last championship match to Zenit (0-2), which ended their long unbeaten streak. In the Russian Cup group stage, Spartak finished first in their group, while Lokomotiv came in second. The teams have already met in the league this season, with Lokomotiv securing a 4-2 victory. Spartak has an impressive home record against the 'Railwaymen,' remaining unbeaten in the last 8 encounters (6 wins, 2 draws).

Team Form and Analysis

Spartak Moskva

The 'Red-Whites,' despite their instability in the league, look confident in the Russian Cup, especially at home. Dejan Stanković's side finished first in their group, ahead of Dynamo Makhachkala. However, Spartak has significant personnel problems in defense, with Srdjan Babić and Aleksandr Dzhikiya missing the match due to injury. Nevertheless, Spartak is unbeaten at home in their last four matches, securing three wins.

Lokomotiv Moskva

The 'Railwaymen,' under Mikhail Galaktionov, have shown consistent results, losing only 1 of their last 17 matches. The team performs successfully away from home, having lost only once in their last 9 away games. Loko has been prolific on the road, scoring 2 or more goals in 8 of their last 10 away matches. However, the 'Railwaymen' also have personnel losses: Dmitry Vorobyov and Sergey Pinyaev are injured.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Spartak (4-3-3): Pomazun; Zobnin, Vu, Litvinov, Ryabchuk; Prutsev, Umyarov, Martins; Zinkovskiy, Sobolev, Bongonda.
  • Lokomotiv (4-2-3-1): Lantratov; Nenakhov, Morozov, Kuzmichev, Samoshnikov; Barinov, Karpukas; Zhamaletdinov, Miranchuk, Glushenkov; Suleymanov.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Lokomotiv's recent dip, it is the 'Railwaymen' who look like slight favorites in this derby. Their overall consistency throughout the season and Spartak's defensive problems could be decisive factors. However, Spartak traditionally plays well against Loko at home and will be extremely motivated.

  • Main Prediction: Both teams to score. The last four head-to-head meetings between these teams have ended with both sides finding the net and have been very high-scoring. Given the attacking potential of both sides and their defensive issues, this outcome seems highly likely.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Recent head-to-head matches between the teams have consistently been 'over,' with 30 goals scored in the last six encounters. There is every reason to believe that this game will be no exception.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Europa League group stage, where French side OGC Nice hosts Germany's SC Freiburg at the Allianz Riviera. This is a key confrontation between direct competitors for qualification to the knockout stages from Group F.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 17:45 UTC (20:45 MSK) Stadium: Allianz Riviera, Nice Competition: UEFA Europa League

Nice vs Freiburg: Match Preview

Nice comes into this match as the group leader, with 7 points from three games. 'The Eaglets' have secured two wins and a draw, and in the previous round, they narrowly defeated Freiburg 1-0 away thanks to a goal from Terem Moffi. Freiburg, with three points, sits in third place and is in desperate need of revenge to keep their qualification hopes alive. Francesco Farioli's team is in excellent form at home, having been unbeaten in their last eight matches at the Allianz Riviera. In contrast, Freiburg has struggled in away games, losing three of their last four European matches on the road.

Team Form and Analysis

Nice

Nice relies on a solid defense, which is one of the best in Ligue 1. In the Europa League, the team has conceded only one goal in three matches. In their last league fixture, 'the Eaglets' secured a 2-1 victory over Lens, confirming their good form. However, the team has some personnel issues: key midfielder Youssouf Ndayishimiye will miss the match due to injury, and the participation of Sofiane Diop is in doubt.

Freiburg

Christian Streich's team is going through a rough patch, with only one win in their last five matches. Last weekend, the 'Brazilians of Breisgau' lost to Borussia Mönchengladbach in the Bundesliga. Freiburg's main strength lies in set pieces, where Vincenzo Grifo is particularly dangerous. However, their away form and a historically poor record against French clubs (only one win in five matches) pose a serious problem for the German side.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Nice (4-3-3): Bulka; Lotomba, Todibo, Dante, Bard; Sanson, Rosario, Thuram; Boga, Moffi, Laborde.
  • Freiburg (3-4-3): Atubolu; Ginter, Lienhart, Gulde; Sildillia, Eggestein, Höfler, Günter; Dōan, Gregoritsch, Grifo.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Nice are the favorites for this encounter. The home-field advantage, where the team rarely drops points, their current form, and the result of the first match all point in favor of the French club. It will be extremely difficult for Freiburg to break their poor away streak against such an organized opponent.

  • Main Prediction: Nice to Win. 'The Eaglets' will aim to secure their spot in the knockout stages early and are likely to defeat a struggling Freiburg side.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. The first match between the teams was low-scoring. Given Nice's defensive style and the importance of the match, a goal fest is not expected.

Sturm Graz vs Nottingham Forest: Match Preview

Both teams approach this head-to-head meeting in less than ideal form. Sturm, the reigning Austrian champions, have suffered two consecutive defeats in the Bundesliga, dropping to fourth place. In the Europa League, the Austrians lost both of their away matches but managed to defeat Rangers 2-1 at home, extending their European home winning streak to four games. Nottingham Forest is also experiencing significant difficulties in the English Premier League, where the team has been winless in their last nine matches. In their most recent fixture, the 'Tricky Trees' let a lead slip against Manchester United, drawing 2-2. In Europe, Sean Dyche's side has also been inconsistent, earning 4 points from three matches. These teams have met only twice before, way back in the 1983/84 season, with Nottingham coming out on top (one win, one draw).

Team Form and Analysis

Sturm Graz

Jürgen Säumel's team is in a slump, having lost three of their last four matches in all competitions. The team's main problems lie in defense. However, Sturm is traditionally strong at home in European competitions. The attack is led by Otar Kiteishvili and Tomi Horvat, who have each scored three goals in the last 10 games. The Austrians have a significant absence: midfielder Tochi Chukwuani is suspended for the match.

Nottingham Forest

The 'Tricky Trees' are in a prolonged crisis, especially in away matches, where the team is yet to win this season. Forest's defense is also a major concern, having conceded at least two goals in five of their last six games. Adding to their on-field problems is an injury epidemic, with Chris Wood, Ola Aina, Aurélien Tchouaméni, and Oleksandr Zinchenko all on the sidelines. Furthermore, striker Igor Jesus will miss the match due to an accumulation of yellow cards.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Sturm Graz (4-4-2): Christensen; Oermann, Aiwu, Lavalée, Karić; Gorenc Stanković, Rózga, Horvat, Kiteishvili; Grgić, Malone.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although bookmakers consider Nottingham Forest the favorites, their terrible away form and personnel issues cast doubt on this status. Sturm is also not at their best, but their ability to perform at home in European competitions could be a decisive factor.

  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. Sturm has scored in their last four games, while Nottingham concedes in almost every match. Given the unreliable defenses of both teams, an exchange of goals is highly likely.

Midtjylland vs Celtic: Match Preview

The teams come into this head-to-head meeting with identical records: 7 points each after three rounds. The previous match in Glasgow ended in a hard-fought 2-2 draw, where the Scottish side rescued a point in the final minutes. Midtjylland is in good form, having won three of their last four matches. In their last Europa League fixture, the Danes comfortably defeated Bodø/Glimt 3-1. Celtic is also dominating domestically, but in their last European outing, they failed to overcome the same Bodø/Glimt away from home. The head-to-head history between these clubs includes three matches, with Celtic yet to lose (one win, two draws), and their only victory came in Herning back in 2021.

Team Form and Analysis

Midtjylland

Thomas Thomasberg's team displays a powerful attacking style of football, especially at home. 'The Wolves' are unbeaten in their last six home matches across all competitions. In the Europa League, the Danes have scored 7 goals in three games, which is one of the best records in the tournament. However, the team has some injury concerns: key midfielder Armin Gigović and forward Marrony will miss the match due to injury.

Celtic

'The Hoops,' under Brendan Rodgers, also rely on their attack. The team scores a lot, but their defense is not always reliable, as the first match against Midtjylland showed. Celtic will aim to use their attacking strengths, with Japanese forward Kyogo Furuhashi and Portuguese winger Jota being the main threats. The Scottish club will try to extend their five-game unbeaten streak against Danish teams.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the third matchday of the UEFA Conference League league phase, where Ukraine's Shakhtar Donetsk hosts Icelandic champions Breidablik at their nominal home stadium in Krakow. For the 'Miners,' this is an excellent opportunity to bounce back from a disappointing defeat in the last round and strengthen their position in the fight for a top spot.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 17:45 UTC (20:45 MSK) Stadium: Henryk Reyman's Municipal Stadium, Krakow Competition: UEFA Conference League

Shakhtar Donetsk vs Breidablik: Match Preview

Shakhtar comes into this match in high spirits after a 3-1 victory in the Ukrainian 'Clasico' against Dynamo Kyiv, which solidified their first-place position in the UPL. In the Conference League, the 'Miners' have had mixed results so far: an away win against Aberdeen (3-2) was followed by a frustrating home loss to Legia Warsaw (1-2), with the decisive goal conceded in the final seconds. Breidablik, on the other hand, is one of the tournament's underdogs. The season in Iceland has already concluded, with the team finishing in fourth place, thus missing out on European competition for next season. In the Conference League, the Icelandic side has yet to secure a victory. This will be the first official meeting between the clubs.

Team Form and Analysis

Shakhtar Donetsk

The 'Miners' are considered one of the tournament favorites and will be aiming for a top-8 finish to avoid the knockout play-off round. The team has sufficient squad depth to compete on two fronts. The victory over Dynamo should have boosted their confidence after a loss to the same opponent in the Ukrainian Cup. Shakhtar has several players out with injuries, including Lassina Traoré and Dmytro Kryskiv, but their absence should not be critical against such an opponent.

Breidablik

For the Icelandic club, qualifying for the main stage of a European competition is already a great success. The team began their journey in the Champions League qualifiers but eventually dropped down to the Conference League. As the Icelandic season has ended, Breidablik has not had any official match practice since late October, which is a significant disadvantage. In their history, Breidablik has faced a Ukrainian club only once - in the 2023/24 season, they lost twice to Zorya Luhansk.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Shakhtar (4-1-4-1): Riznyk; Konoplia, Bondar, Matviyenko, Azarov; Stepanenko; Zubkov, Bondarenko, Sudakov, Kevin; Sikan.
  • Breidablik (4-3-3): Einarsson; Gunnlaugsson, Muminović, Margeirsson, Jónsson; Sigurjónsson, Einarsson, Steindórsson; Yeoman, Úlfarsson, Ómarsson.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Shakhtar is the undisputed favorite in this matchup. The difference in class, current match fitness, and the advantage of their (albeit nominal) home ground make a victory for the Ukrainian club almost a foregone conclusion. It will be extremely difficult for Breidablik, who have already finished their season, to offer any resistance to the motivated 'Miners.'

  • Main Prediction: Shakhtar to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. The 'Miners' should comfortably beat the group's underdog to avoid complicating their path to the knockout stages.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Shakhtar has a powerful attack, and against a modest opponent, the team is likely to treat its fans to plenty of goals.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Europa League league phase, where Dutch side FC Utrecht hosts one of the giants of Portuguese football, FC Porto, at their Stadion Galgenwaard. For the hosts, who have had a disastrous start to the tournament, this is the last chance to keep their playoff hopes alive, while the 'Dragons' are aiming to bounce back from their defeat in the last round.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 17:45 UTC (20:45 MSK) Stadium: Stadion Galgenwaard, Utrecht Competition: UEFA Europa League

Utrecht vs Porto: Match Preview

Utrecht comes into this match in dreadful form in the Europa League. Ron Jans's side has lost all three of their opening matches without scoring a single goal. Defeats to Lyon, Brann, and Freiburg have dropped the Dutch club to second-to-last in the overall standings. Porto, in contrast, started with two wins but suffered a surprising 2-0 away defeat to Nottingham Forest in the last round, their only loss of the season. The teams are also showing different results in their domestic leagues: Porto is leading in Portugal, while Utrecht is in the mid-table of the Eredivisie. The only previous meetings between these teams took place way back in 1982, with Porto winning both matches.

Team Form and Analysis

Utrecht

The Dutch club is experiencing a major crisis, especially in European competitions, where the team has been winless in 14 consecutive matches since 2004. Utrecht's main problem is their attack; they have yet to score in the Europa League. Adding to their on-field struggles are significant personnel issues. Key defender Mike van der Hoorn and top scorer from qualifying Victor Jensen will miss the match due to injury, along with several other squad players. The only positive note is a recent clean-sheet victory in the league, their first in two months.

Porto

Francesco Farioli's team responded to their setback in England with two comeback wins in the league, demonstrating good character. The 'Dragons' will be aiming to return to winning ways in Europe as well. However, Porto also has personnel problems, especially in attack, with main striker Luuk de Jong and winger Yann Karamoh injured. Defender Nehuén Pérez is also in the infirmary. Nevertheless, the squad depth and the return of midfielder Tomás Pérez keep Porto as the clear favorites.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Utrecht (4-3-3): Barkas; Horemans, Eerdhuijzen, Viergever, El Karouani; Engwanda, Zechiel, Bozdogan; Rodriguez, Blake, Alle.
  • Porto (4-4-2): Costa; Moura, Bednarek, Kiwior, A. Costa; Rosario, Varela, Froholdt, Pepê; Sainz, Samu.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Porto is the undisputed favorite in this encounter. Their consistency, the quality of their players, and Utrecht's dreadful form in European competitions make a victory for the Portuguese club the most likely outcome. It will be extremely difficult for the Dutch side, with their personnel problems and lack of goals, to offer any resistance to the motivated 'Dragons.'

  • Main Prediction: Porto to Win with a (-1) Handicap. After their defeat in the last round, Porto will be focused on nothing less than a convincing victory against the group's main underdog.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Despite Utrecht's attacking struggles, Porto plays an open style and allows opponents to play as well. Recent matches for both teams have often seen a high total of goals.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Conference League group stage, where Cypriot side AEK Larnaca hosts Scotland's Aberdeen at the AEK Arena. For the hosts, this is a chance to virtually guarantee their place in the knockout rounds, while for the visitors, it may be their last opportunity to stay in the fight for qualification.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 17:45 UTC (20:45 MSK) Stadium: AEK Arena - Georgios Karapatakis, Larnaca Competition: UEFA Conference League

AEK Larnaca vs Aberdeen: Match Preview

The teams come into this match at opposite ends of the group table. AEK has been one of the tournament's surprise packages, securing two wins from their opening two matches: a 4-0 thrashing of AZ Alkmaar and a sensational 1-0 away victory against Crystal Palace. In contrast, Aberdeen has had a disastrous start, losing both of their games to Shakhtar Donetsk (3-2) and AEK Athens (6-0), leaving them bottom of the table with zero points. The Scottish club is also struggling domestically, sitting ninth in their league. This will be the first-ever official meeting between the clubs.

Team Form and Analysis

AEK Larnaca

Imanol Idiakez's side is in excellent form. The Cypriots have won four of their last five European home games and are unbeaten in their last five matches across all competitions. The 'Guardians' have demonstrated a solid defense, having not conceded a single goal in the Conference League, and have been effective in attack, with four of their five goals coming in the second half. However, the team has some injury concerns, with Angel Garcia, Enzo Cabrera, Kewin Komar, and Yerson Chacon all set to miss out.

Aberdeen

The 'Dons' are enduring a tough season, having won just four of their 16 matches in all competitions. The team has conceded a competition-high nine goals in the Conference League. Despite this, three of their four wins this season have come on the road, including their most recent 1-0 victory over Kilmarnock. The Scots have a decent historical record against Cypriot teams (3 wins, 1 loss), but their only defeat came on their last visit to Cyprus in 2017.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • AEK Larnaca (4-2-3-1): Alomerovic; Gnali, Milicevic, Roberge, Saborit; Pons, Ledes; Miramon, Rohden, Ivanovic; Bajic.
  • Aberdeen (4-4-2): Roos; Devlin, MacDonald, Jensen, MacKenzie; Miovski, Clarkson, Shinnie, Hayes; Lazetic, Sokler.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

AEK Larnaca are the clear favorites for this encounter. Their excellent form in European competition, strong home performances, and the opponent's deep crisis make a victory for the Cypriot club the most likely outcome. It will be extremely difficult for Aberdeen to offer any resistance to the motivated hosts.

  • Main Prediction: AEK Larnaca to Win. The Cypriots are on a roll, and another victory would almost certainly see them through to the knockout stages. Given Aberdeen's problems, especially in defense, the hosts should comfortably take all three points.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Six of AEK's nine home games this season have seen more than 2.5 goals. Aberdeen has been conceding a lot, which sets the stage for a high-scoring match.

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the most anticipated matches of the fourth round of the UEFA Europa League group stage, where Scotland's Rangers host Italy's Roma at their legendary Ibrox Stadium in Glasgow. This is a battle between the two group favorites for the top spot, promising to be a true test of character.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Ibrox Stadium, Glasgow Competition: UEFA Europa League

Rangers vs Roma: Match Preview

Roma comes into this match as the group leader, with a maximum of 9 points from three games. Rangers follow in second place with six points. The previous meeting between these teams in Rome ended in a narrow 2-1 victory for Roma, where the Scottish side put up a worthy fight. Rangers are in excellent form domestically, but in the last Europa League round, they lost away to Sturm Graz (1-2). Roma, under Daniele De Rossi, is also showing consistent results in Serie A and has won all three of their European matches. The Scottish club is unbeaten in six European home games, and the support from the Ibrox crowd will be their main advantage.

Team Form and Analysis

Rangers

Philippe Clement's team traditionally performs strongly at home, especially in European matches. The Gers rely on high pressing, fast wing attacks, and set pieces, where captain James Tavernier is particularly dangerous. Despite the defeat in Austria, Rangers are a completely different team at home. However, the Scottish side has some injury concerns: midfielder Ryan Jack and forward Danilo may miss the match.

Roma

The 'Wolves' under De Rossi play pragmatic and effective football. The team boasts one of the best defenses in Serie A and has world-class attacking talent, such as Paulo Dybala and Romelu Lukaku. Roma is unbeaten in their last eight matches in all competitions. The Italian club will aim to at least avoid defeat in Glasgow to maintain a comfortable lead in the group. However, a trip to Ibrox is always a serious challenge for any team.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

Despite Roma's status as group favorites, the match at Ibrox promises to be extremely difficult for the Italian club. Rangers, with the backing of their home crowd, are capable of challenging any opponent. The first game showed that the teams are quite evenly matched.

  • Main Prediction: Both teams to score. Rangers almost always score at home, and the attacking power of Roma with Dybala and Lukaku is beyond doubt. An exchange of goals in such a game looks like the most likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Matches at Ibrox in European competitions are often high-scoring due to the hosts' attacking style. Considering the quality of Roma's attacking players, a high-scoring match can be expected.

Stuttgart vs Feyenoord: Match Preview

Stuttgart comes into this match as the clear leader of the group, with a maximum point haul after three rounds. Sebastian Hoeneß's side is in magnificent form, having won all three of their opening Europa League matches, including a 2-1 away victory over Feyenoord in the last round. Feyenoord, with six points, sits in second place and will be eager for revenge to keep their chances of finishing first alive. Both teams are in excellent form in their domestic leagues as well, where they are competing for the top spots. Stuttgart has won their last six matches in all competitions, while Feyenoord is unbeaten in their last five games.

Team Form and Analysis

Stuttgart

'The Swabians' are one of the main revelations of the European season. The team plays an exciting and high-scoring brand of football. In their last six matches, Stuttgart has scored 22 goals, averaging over 3.5 goals per game. The team is particularly strong at home, having won 9 of their last 10 matches. The attack is led by striker Serhou Guirassy, who is in phenomenal form. However, Stuttgart has significant personnel issues: Deniz Undav, Dan-Axel Zagadou, and Nikolas Nartey will miss the match due to injury.

Feyenoord

The Rotterdam club, under the guidance of Brian Priske, also relies on attacking football. The team scores a lot, but their defense is not always reliable, as the first match against Stuttgart showed. Feyenoord has been successful in away matches, winning four of their last five games on the road. The team's leader is Mexican striker Santiago Giménez. The Dutch club also has some personnel losses, but they are not as critical as their opponent's.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Stuttgart (4-2-3-1): Nübel; Vagnoman, Anton, Ito, Mittelstädt; Karazor, Stiller; Leweling, Millot, Führich; Guirassy.
  • Feyenoord (4-3-3): Bijlow; Geertruida, Trauner, Hancko, Hartman; Wieffer, Timber, Stengs; Jahanbakhsh, Giménez, Paixão.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The match promises to be one of the most entertaining of this stage of the tournament. It features two attacking teams in excellent form. Stuttgart has the home-field advantage and a psychological edge after their away win, but Feyenoord will do everything to get their revenge.

  • Main Prediction: Both teams to score. Both teams are high-scoring and do not have perfect defenses. An exchange of goals in such a game seems almost inevitable.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. 9 of Stuttgart's last 10 home matches have seen three or more goals. Feyenoord also regularly participates in high-scoring matches. The clash of the group leaders promises to be a goal-fest.

Aston Villa vs Maccabi Tel Aviv: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Europa League league phase, where England's Aston Villa hosts Israel's Maccabi Tel Aviv at Villa Park.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Villa Park, Birmingham Competition: UEFA Europa League

Aston Villa vs Maccabi Tel Aviv: Match Preview

Aston Villa comes into this match sitting 10th in the overall Europa League standings with six points from three games. Unai Emery's side has secured two victories but suffered a surprise 2-1 away defeat to Go Ahead Eagles in the last round. In the Premier League, Villa lost 2-0 to Liverpool last weekend. Maccabi, on the other hand, has had a disastrous start to their European campaign, earning only one point and sitting in 32nd place. This will be the first-ever official meeting between the clubs.

Team Form and Analysis

Aston Villa

Under Unai Emery, Villa has become a formidable force, especially in European home matches, where the team has won 12 of their last 14 games. Emiliano Buendía, Youri Tielemans, and Tyrone Mings will miss the match due to injuries. Despite these absences, the squad depth and Emery's tactical flexibility keep Villa as the clear favorites.

Maccabi Tel Aviv

The 'Yellows' are competing for the top spot in the Israeli Premier League but have yet to find their footing in Europe. The team does not have a successful history against English clubs, having lost all four of their previous encounters. The away section for Maccabi fans will be closed. The team has no major injury concerns.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Aston Villa (4-4-2): Martinez; Cash, Lindelof, Torres, Maatsen; Onana, Bogarde; Sancho, Elliott, Malen; Watkins.
  • Maccabi Tel Aviv (4-3-3): Mishpati; Asante, Shlomo, Camara, Revivo; Belic, Sissokho; Davida, Andrade, Varela; Peretz.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Aston Villa are the undisputed favorites for this match. Their powerful performances at Villa Park in European competitions, coupled with Maccabi's poor record against English teams, make a home win the most likely outcome. Unai Emery's side will be eager to bounce back and secure three points.

  • Main Prediction: Aston Villa to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Aston Villa to Win to Nil.

Dynamo Kyiv vs Zrinjski: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Conference League league phase, where Dynamo Kyiv hosts the champions of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Zrinjski Mostar, at their nominal home stadium in Lublin. For the Kyiv side, this is a crucial match in the fight for a playoff spot, while for the visitors, it's a chance to cause another upset.

Kick-off: November 6, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Arena Lublin, Lublin Competition: UEFA Conference League

Dynamo Kyiv vs Zrinjski: Match Preview

Dynamo comes into this match in a difficult psychological state after a 3-1 defeat in the Ukrainian 'Clasico' against Shakhtar Donetsk. In the Conference League, Kyiv's fortunes have also been mixed: after three rounds, they have only three points, earned in a home game against AGF Aarhus, and sit in 25th place in the overall standings. Zrinjski, on the other hand, has been one of the tournament's surprise packages. After an opening defeat to Viktoria Plzeň, the Bosnian club secured two consecutive victories, including a sensational comeback against AZ Alkmaar (from 0-3 to 4-3). In the previous round, Zrinjski defeated Dynamo 2-0 at home.

Team Form and Analysis

Dynamo Kyiv

Oleksandr Shovkovskyi's team is experiencing serious problems with consistency. Bright performances are interspersed with disastrous ones. Kyiv's main issue is their defense, as the team concedes in almost every match. In attack, all hopes rest on the experience of Andriy Yarmolenko and the youth of Vladyslav Vanat. This match is of decisive importance for Dynamo; a defeat could put an end to their chances of advancing to the playoffs.

Zrinjski

The Bosnian champions are on an emotional high. The team has shown incredible character and a will to win. The 'Noblemen' have already proven that they should not be underestimated. The leader of their attack is striker Nemanja Bilbija, who is in excellent form. Zrinjski will aim to at least avoid defeat in Lublin to maintain a comfortable advantage over Dynamo in the table.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Dynamo Kyiv (4-2-3-1): Bushchan; Tymchyk, Popov, Syrota, Dubinchak; Brazhko, Shaparenko; Yarmolenko, Buyalskyi, Voloshyn; Vanat.
  • Zrinjski (4-3-3): Marić; Ćorluka, Jakovljević, Radić, Memija; Ivančić, Canadjija, Stanić; Kuze, Bilbija, Tičinović.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the defeat in the first match and their less than ideal form, Dynamo are the favorites at home. The class of the Ukrainian club's players is higher, and the team will be extremely motivated to get revenge. Zrinjski is dangerous, but their away form in European competitions is not always stable.

  • Main Prediction: Dynamo Kyiv to Win. The Kyiv side has no room for retreat and must give their all for the victory. The factor of their (albeit nominal) home field and the need for revenge should play their part.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Matches involving both teams in this Conference League campaign have been high-scoring. Dynamo needs to bounce back, and Zrinjski has shown they know how to find the net.
